scope: Finite exact evidence; no divergent orbit, solution, or novelty established.

arithmetic.primality: Complete n-1 Lucas certificates or trial proof through 1000; Miller-Rabin only rejects.
arithmetic.factorization: Bounded deterministic Pollard-Brent plus old-prime stripping; certified prime cache.
arithmetic.work: Factorization-only budgets; stripping is separate (at most twice the source bit cap). Deterministic arithmetic counts, not timings or bit complexity; trial units differ.
arithmetic.independent: Additive sieve for census; explicit divisor enumeration and Lucas-proof replay for every orbit edge.
arithmetic.comparison: Whole/sparse methods begin each paired input with identical prime-proof caches; sparse stripping counted separately.
arithmetic.projection: Coordinates 2,3,5,7 only; not an autonomous Markov state; shared tails are not independent samples.

symbolicExample.scope: No expanded integer or next factorization constructed; not a continued orbit.
